s.t: Jack and his mother really needed money.
s.fr: Jack et sa mère avaient vraiment besoin d’argent.

s.t: Jack sold their cow for some beans.
s.fr: Jack vendit leur vache contre des haricots.

s.t: His mother was angry and threw the beans outside.
s.fr: Sa mère était en colère et jeta les haricots dehors.

s.t: Overnight, the beans grew into a tall beanstalk.
s.fr: Pendant la nuit, les haricots poussèrent en une grande tige de haricot.

s.t: Jack climbed up the tall beanstalk.
s.fr: Jack grimpa le long de la grande tige de haricot.

paras.summary: Jack and his mother are poor, so Jack sells their cow for beans; his mother angrily throws them outside, but overnight they grow into a tall beanstalk, and Jack climbs up.

s.t: At the top, Jack saw a house.
s.fr: En haut, Jack vit une maison.

s.t: It was the home of a giant.
s.fr: C’était la demeure d’un géant.

s.t: The giant's wife came to the door.
s.fr: La femme du géant vint à la porte.

s.t: "I have no money and no food," said Jack.
s.fr: « Je n’ai pas d’argent et pas de nourriture », dit Jack.

paras.summary: At the top of the beanstalk Jack finds a house; it is the home of a giant, and the wife answers the door to Jack, who has no money or food.

s.t: "Please may I have some food?"
s.fr: « Puis-je avoir un peu de nourriture, s’il vous plaît ? »

s.t: The wife gave Jack some food.
s.fr: La femme donna un peu de nourriture à Jack.

s.t: "But my husband eats boys, so hide," she said.
s.fr: « Mais mon mari mange les garçons, alors cache-toi », dit-elle.

paras.summary: Jack asks for food and the giant's wife gives him some, but warns that her husband eats boys and Jack must hide.

s.t: Then Jack heard the giant come home.
s.fr: Puis Jack entendit le géant rentrer à la maison.

s.t: The wife hid Jack in the oven.
s.fr: La femme cacha Jack dans le four.

s.t: The giant came in and sat down.
s.fr: Le géant entra et s’assit.

paras.summary: Jack hears the giant coming, so the wife hides him in the oven; the giant comes in and sits down.

s.t: The giant looked around.
s.fr: Le géant regarda autour de lui.

s.t: "I smell a boy in this house!"
s.fr: « Je sens l’odeur d’un garçon dans cette maison ! »

paras.summary: The giant looks around the room and declares that he smells a boy in the house.

s.t: "There is no boy here," said the wife.
s.fr: « Il n’y a pas de garçon ici », dit la femme.

s.t: The giant sat down and ate his food.
s.fr: Le géant s’assit et mangea sa nourriture.

paras.summary: The wife tells the giant no boy is there, and the giant sits down and eats his food.

s.t: Then the giant took out his gold.
s.fr: Puis le géant sortit son or.

s.t: He counted the gold again and again.
s.fr: Il compta l’or encore et encore.

s.t: The giant had many bags of gold.
s.fr: Le géant avait de nombreux sacs d’or.

s.t: The giant fell asleep.
s.fr: Le géant s’endormit.

paras.summary: The giant takes out his gold, counts the many bags again and again, and then falls asleep.

s.t: Jack came out of the oven.
s.fr: Jack sortit du four.

s.t: He took one bag of the giant's gold.
s.fr: Il prit un sac de l’or du géant.

s.t: Then Jack ran to the tall beanstalk.
s.fr: Puis Jack courut vers le grand haricot.

s.t: He climbed down with the heavy bag.
s.fr: Il descendit avec le lourd sac.

paras.summary: Jack creeps out of the oven, takes one bag of the giant's gold, and runs to the beanstalk to climb down.

s.t: "Mother, look at this gold!" said Jack.
s.fr: « Maman, regarde cet or ! » dit Jack.

s.t: Now Jack and his mother had money again.
s.fr: Maintenant, Jack et sa mère avaient de nouveau de l’argent.

paras.summary: Jack shows his mother the gold, and they have money again.

s.t: Jack gave the gold to his mother.
s.fr: Jack donna l’or à sa mère.

s.t: But one day all the gold was gone.
s.fr: Mais un jour, tout l’or était parti.

s.t: "I will climb the beanstalk again," said Jack.
s.fr: « Je vais grimper de nouveau sur le haricot magique », dit Jack.

paras.summary: Jack gives the gold to his mother, but one day it is all gone, so Jack decides to climb the beanstalk again.

s.t: Jack climbed up to the giant's house.
s.fr: Jack grimpa jusqu’à la maison du géant.

s.t: The giant's wife was at the door.
s.fr: La femme du géant était à la porte.

s.t: "You took our gold!" said the wife.
s.fr: « Tu as pris notre or ! » dit la femme.

paras.summary: Jack climbs back to the giant's house, where the wife meets him at the door and accuses him of taking their gold.

s.t: "Please let me hide again," said Jack.
s.fr: « S’il te plaît, laisse-moi me cacher de nouveau », dit Jack.

s.t: The kind wife gave Jack some food.
s.fr: La gentille femme donna un peu de nourriture à Jack.

paras.summary: Jack begs to hide again, and the kind wife gives him food.

s.t: Then they heard the giant come home.
s.fr: Puis ils entendirent le géant rentrer à la maison.

s.t: The wife hid Jack in a big pot.
s.fr: La femme cacha Jack dans un grand pot.

s.t: The giant came in for his food.
s.fr: Le géant entra pour prendre sa nourriture.

paras.summary: They hear the giant come home, so the wife hides Jack in a big pot; the giant comes in looking for his food.

s.t: "No boy is here," said the wife again.
s.fr: « Aucun garçon n’est ici », dit de nouveau la femme.

s.t: The giant ate all of his food.
s.fr: Le géant mangea toute sa nourriture.

paras.summary: The wife again says no boy is there, and the giant eats all of his food.

s.t: Then the giant brought out a little hen.
s.fr: Puis le géant sortit une petite poule.

s.t: "Lay!" said the giant to the hen.
s.fr: « Ponds ! » dit le géant à la poule.

s.t: The hen laid an egg of gold.
s.fr: La poule pondit un œuf d’or.

s.t: The giant looked at his egg of gold.
s.fr: Le géant regarda son œuf d’or.

s.t: Soon the giant fell asleep again.
s.fr: Bientôt le géant s’endormit de nouveau.

paras.summary: The giant brings out a little hen, commands it to lay, and it lays an egg of gold; the giant looks at the egg and then falls asleep.

s.t: Jack came out and took the hen.
s.fr: Jack sortit et prit la poule.

s.t: He ran to the tall beanstalk with the hen.
s.fr: Il courut vers le grand haricot avec la poule.

s.t: Jack climbed down to his mother.
s.fr: Jack descendit jusqu’à sa mère.

paras.summary: Jack takes the hen, runs to the beanstalk, and climbs down to his mother.

s.t: "This hen lays eggs of gold!" said Jack.
s.fr: « Cette poule pond des œufs d’or ! » dit Jack.

s.t: Now Jack and his mother were rich.
s.fr: Désormais Jack et sa mère étaient riches.

paras.summary: Jack tells his mother the hen lays eggs of gold, and now they are rich.

s.t: Now Jack had the hen and the gold.
s.fr: Maintenant, Jack avait la poule et l’or.

s.t: But Jack wanted to climb up once more.
s.fr: Mais Jack voulait grimper une fois de plus.

s.t: "Stay home, Jack," said his mother.
s.fr: « Reste à la maison, Jack », dit sa mère.

s.t: But Jack climbed the beanstalk again.
s.fr: Mais Jack grimpa de nouveau le haricot magique.

paras.summary: Jack has the hen and the gold, but he wants to climb once more; his mother tells him to stay home, yet Jack climbs the beanstalk again.

s.t: Soon he was at the giant's house.
s.fr: Bientôt, il fut à la maison du géant.

s.t: The giant's wife saw Jack come in.
s.fr: La femme du géant vit Jack entrer.

paras.summary: Jack reaches the giant's house, and the wife sees him come in.

s.t: "You are here again!" said the wife.
s.fr: « Tu es encore ici ! » dit la femme.

s.t: But she let Jack hide once more.
s.fr: Mais elle laissa Jack se cacher une fois de plus.

s.t: The wife hid Jack in a cupboard.
s.fr: La femme cacha Jack dans un placard.

paras.summary: The wife is surprised to see Jack again but lets him hide, putting him in a cupboard.

s.t: Soon the giant came home for food.
s.fr: Bientôt, le géant rentra à la maison pour manger.

s.t: "I smell a boy here!" said the giant.
s.fr: « Je sens un garçon ici ! » dit le géant.

paras.summary: The giant comes home looking for food and announces that he smells a boy.

s.t: Again the wife said no boy was there.
s.fr: De nouveau, la femme dit qu’aucun garçon n’était là.

s.t: The giant ate his big dinner.
s.fr: Le géant mangea son grand dîner.

paras.summary: The wife again denies any boy is there, and the giant eats his big dinner.

s.t: Then the giant brought out a gold harp.
s.fr: Puis le géant sortit une harpe en or.

s.t: "Sing for me!" said the giant.
s.fr: « Chante pour moi ! » dit le géant.

s.t: The gold harp sang a soft song.
s.fr: La harpe en or chanta une chanson douce.

s.t: Soon the music made the giant sleep.
s.fr: Bientôt, la musique endormit le géant.

paras.summary: The giant brings out a gold harp and tells it to sing; the harp sings a soft song until the music sends the giant to sleep.

s.t: Jack jumped up and grabbed the harp.
s.fr: Jack se leva d’un bond et saisit la harpe.

s.t: But the harp called out to the giant.
s.fr: Mais la harpe appela le géant.

s.t: "Master! Master!" cried the gold harp.
s.fr: « Maître ! Maître ! » cria la harpe en or.

paras.summary: Jack jumps up and grabs the harp, but it cries out for its master.

s.t: The giant woke up in a rage.
s.fr: Le géant se réveilla dans une rage.

s.t: He ran after Jack with big steps.
s.fr: Il courut après Jack à grands pas.

s.t: Jack raced down the tall beanstalk.
s.fr: Jack dévala le grand haricot magique.

paras.summary: The giant wakes in a rage and runs after Jack; Jack races down the beanstalk.

s.t: Jack climbed down the tall beanstalk fast.
s.fr: Jack descendit rapidement le grand haricot magique.

s.t: The giant climbed down after him.
s.fr: Le géant descendit à sa poursuite.

paras.summary: Jack climbs down the tall beanstalk fast, with the giant climbing down after him.

s.t: "Mother, bring me the axe!" called Jack.
s.fr: « Mère, apporte-moi la hache ! » cria Jack.

s.t: His mother ran out with a big axe.
s.fr: Sa mère accourut avec une grande hache.

s.t: Jack took the axe and began to cut.
s.fr: Jack prit la hache et commença à couper.

s.t: He cut and cut the tall beanstalk.
s.fr: Il coupa et coupa le grand haricot magique.

paras.summary: Jack calls for an axe; his mother brings it, and Jack begins to cut the beanstalk again and again.

s.t: The tall beanstalk broke in two.
s.fr: Le grand haricot magique se brisa en deux.

s.t: The giant fell to the ground and died.
s.fr: Le géant tomba par terre et mourut.

paras.summary: The beanstalk breaks in two and the giant falls to the ground and dies.

s.t: Jack and his mother were safe at last.
s.fr: Jack et sa mère étaient enfin en sécurité.

s.t: They still had the gold, the hen, and the harp.
s.fr: Ils avaient encore l’or, la poule et la harpe.

s.t: Jack and his mother were rich for life.
s.fr: Jack et sa mère furent riches pour la vie.

paras.summary: Jack and his mother are safe at last; they still have the gold, the hen, and the harp, and they are rich for life.
